page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 dedicated physical cores with 32 vCPUs (1.0 thread per core) and 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 2.0 GB per core memory allocation. The CPU includes 33 MB of L3 cache and supports AVX, AVX-512F, AES, and FMA instructions. It operates on a KVM hypervisor, lacks local storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25%, with single-threaded gzip compression rated in the bottom 10%. However, the server leverages its 32 dedicated cores to achieve average multi-core performance across stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is average for both cached small blocks and uncached large blocks, though the Passmark memory score is relatively weak.

Given its compute-heavy, lower-RAM ratio and lack of local storage, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for parallelized workloads that do not require massive per-core memory footprints. It is well-suited for multi-threaded tasks such as software compilation, ray tracing, static web serving, and moderate database operations. It can also handle small to medium LLM inference prompt processing at average speeds, though text generation performance is weaker.
